SELECT * INTO DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD_bu_20230918 FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD
Select column_name from information_schema.columns where table_name = 'FactDepositsOutstandingBalance' and table_schema = 'dw'
---
WITH Latest AS (
    SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY AccountID ORDER BY BusinessDateSK DESC) AS RowNumber, * 
    FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD ---ORDER BY AccountID, RowNumber
    )
---SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Latest WHERE RowNumber = 1
INSERT INTO DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD (
    BusinessDateSK
    ,BranchSK
    ,BankSK
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDFull
    ,AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDProrated
    ,SourceSystemCode
    ,WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm
)

    20230601 AS BusinessDateSK
    ,BranchSK
    ,BankSK
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDFull
    ,AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDProrated
    ,SourceSystemCode
    ,WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId

FROM Latest WHERE RowNumber = 1
